# Nearcarta

https://nearcarta.vercel.app
https://github.com/nearcarta/nearcarta#readme

A town of shops. The Lamplighter proposes a payment. The charter contract allows it or refuses it on NEAR mainnet.

The visitor charter is one row on board.nearcarta.near. The live code hash is 51kKGvtV23SsZL4JCjD1135yqarHAGnBQ7DybLU4GDGX (read from chain with view_account on 2026-11-12). Deploy: https://nearblocks.io/txns/5Zp4i6nySszG8c41Up79ENFQjSsPRHrLMkc5dLREKdrV

The three links below were made on an earlier build of the same contract (code hash 6aBm6TugZzge9uHDpSsr6pG7XPfZm22JoZ8XZxknRGsa, deploy https://nearblocks.io/txns/CaZr8GmMM83WUEESUShTiKtth8PWgxtRTesYGs1mkdpt).

An allowed payment of 0.001 NEAR: https://nearblocks.io/txns/8WDqBeaN7tCs8zPoYUPAicWhAF38YXgg5Si1YLpeD1aR
A refusal over the per-payment cap: https://nearblocks.io/txns/CcPMX1DtMJ8UyCm4toUHossrFTrHhVKXrSe6L69s9ceF
A refusal because the payee is not on the list: https://nearblocks.io/txns/E7KMexjSGrD81BQuxVHWinyzvur63m6TGiw7bWjs1ubZ

One recorded swap: 0.045 wNEAR became 0.177937 USDC. https://nearblocks.io/txns/HzgUr618CQqxECR88QKW93yGbDoFU176vWQfWM3yZaUw

The API signs mainnet in two places only. The relayer (relayer.nearcarta.near) sends Market Day moves that the player signed and pays their gas, within caps per visitor and per day. The box sends keeper restocks that a keeper's agent key signed after a verified NEAR AI decision. New quotes stay dry. A Pay checkout is at most 0.20 USD and does not send the deposit.

The board wasm has no access key.

Tracks: Ferry is DeFi, Mist Bank is Privacy, Chronicle and Toll Bridge are Autonomous Business, Guardhouse is AI Security, Town Hall is Agent Economy, Payouts is Real-World Money, Vault Arena is Games, Your House is Open.

Payouts run one at a time. Each payment is at most 0.005 NEAR. The daily budget on a visitor row is 0.01 NEAR.

This file says the same thing to people and to agents. Nothing on the site is hidden from people.
